blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding (IBFU) aims to directly perform fine-grained classification and semantic description generation from encoded image byte sequences. In contrast to conventional pixel-domain visual understanding, IBFU conducts semantic analysis without fully decoding images into the pixel domain. Since pixel-level visual content is not explicitly reconstructed during inference, this paradigm reduces visual exposure within the processing pipeline and suits for privacy-friendly Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) applications.
In this paper, we propose Bitstream Fine-grained Generator (BFG), a novel foundation model tailored for IBFU. BFG consists of two main components: a Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) and a Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG). BSeE directly models semantic representations from encoded image bitstream without explicit pixel reconstruction, while FSeG transforms the extracted bitstream semantics into detailed natural-language descriptions through autoregressive generation.
To train BFG and comprehensively evaluate IBFU in practical AIoT scenarios, where image bitstreams may suffer corruption during transmission and storage, we construct a large-scale Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D), containing both intact bitstreams and corrupted variants across multiple corruption types and severity levels.
Experiments show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained caption generation under bitstream corruption. For example, the performance only has slight change from 0.6339 to 0.6077 in terms of average CIDEr score on Stanford Dogs Caption dataset, while vision-language models, such as Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM, Gemini, and GPT suffer severe performance decrease. This paper provides a practical paradigm for privacy-friendly fine-grained understanding in AIoT.
blocks.zh:
图像 Bitstream Fine-Grained Conference (IBFU) 旨在从被编码的图像字节序列中直接进行精细分级和语义描述生成. 与常规像素-域视觉理解相反,IBFU进行语义分析时没有将图像完全解码到像素域. 由于像素层面的视觉内容在推论期间没有被明确重建,这个范式减少了处理管内的视觉曝光,并减少了方便隐私的人工智能(AIoT)应用.
在本文中,我们提出Bitstream Fine-Grained Generator(BFG),这是为IBFU量身定制的新式基础模型. BFG由两大部分组成:一是Bitstream语义编码器(BSeE),一是精致的语义生成器(FSeG). BSeE直接从编码的图像比特流中模拟语义表达,而没有明确像素重建,而FSeG则通过自递生成将所提取的比特流语义转化为详细的自然语言描述.
为了培训BFG并在实用的AIoT情景中全面评价IBFU,即图像比特流在传输和存储过程中可能遭受腐败,我们构建了一个大规模被腐蚀的比特流精细分辨数据集(CFU-D),包含完整比特流和腐败变体,跨越多类腐败和严重程度.
实验显示,BFG在比特流腐败下保持了稳定的精细字幕生成. 例如,从斯坦福犬科Caption数据集的平均CIDER得分来看,性能只有从0.6339到0.6077的微小变化,而视觉语言模型,如Qun-VL-Chat,BLIP-2,GLM,双子座和GPT,则遭遇了严重的性能下降. 本文为AIOT中方便隐私的精细理解提供了实用的范式.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Fig. 1 : Bitstream-domain fine-grained understanding framework for privacy-friendly AIoT.
blocks.zh: 图1:Bitstream-域名精致理解框架 为方便隐私的AIoT.

blocks.en:
Fine-grained visual understanding task aims to distinguish subcategories that differ in subtle visual details. It supports applications in biological analysis [ 1 ] , human-behavior monitoring [ 2 ] , and medical image analysis [ 3 ] . For this task, convolutional neural networks and vision Transformers have achieved strong performance by learning discriminative visual representations [ 4 ] , while image captioning further expresses these visual cues through natural language.
Most fine-grained vision methods are conducted on fully decoded images [ 5 ] . However, images are often stored and transmitted as compressed bitstream in real-world scenarios [ 6 ] , which may be affected by communication or storage faults [ 7 ] . Such corruption may cause visual artifacts or prevent successful decoding [ 8 ] . Methods that use partially decoded DCT features remain dependent on a valid JPEG structure and may become unreliable when the bitstream is structurally damaged [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh:
精细的视觉理解任务旨在区分在微妙的视觉细节上不同的子类. 它支持生物分析[1],人与行为监测[2],和医学图像分析[3]中的应用. 对于这个任务,革命神经网络和视觉变形器通过学习歧视性视觉表现[4]取得了强大的性能,而图像字幕则通过自然语言进一步表达这些视觉提示.
大多数精细的视觉方法都是在完全解码的图像上进行. [5]. 然而,图像在现实世界情景中经常被作为压缩比特流被存储和传输[6],这可能会受到通信或存储断层的影响[7]. 这种腐败可能导致视觉文物,或阻止成功的解码[8]。 部分地使用已解码的DCT特性的方法仍然依赖于有效的JPEG结构,在比特流结构被损坏时可能会变得不可靠 [9].

blocks.en: ByteFormer [ 10 ] and bGPT [ 11 ] show that raw byte sequences can be modeled without conventional image decoding. More recent studies directly target corrupted image bitstreams. CBSU-ALLM treats damaged byte fragments as a specialized language for semantic classification [ 12 ] , while Cibic generates captions from corrupted image bitstreams without pixel reconstruction [ 13 ] . These advances establish privacy-friendly feasible bitstream understanding.
blocks.zh: ByteFormer [10]和bGPT [11] 显示原始字节序列可以在不常规图像解码的情况下被建模. 最近的研究直接针对被腐蚀的图像比特流. CBSU-ALLM将被损坏的字节片段作为语义分类的一种专门语言[12],而Cibic则从被损坏的图像比特流生成标题而无需像素重建[13]. 这些进步建立了方便隐私的可行的比特流理解.

blocks.en:
Aiming at fine-grained bitstream understanding for privacy-friendly Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT), we propose BFG.
In Bitstream Fine-grained Generator(BFG), Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) extracts compact local and global semantics from the byte sequence, and its Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG) aligns these semantics with language tokens to produce detailed descriptions. This design supports both classification and description within a unified bitstream framework.
BFG also provides a privacy-friendly processing path for AIoT. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , smart cameras and edge nodes may capture faces, identities, and private environments that become directly visible to downstream components after RGB reconstruction [ 14 ] . BFG performs semantic inference on encoded bytes and does not explicitly materialize an RGB image within its inference pipeline. It therefore reduces pixel-domain visual exposure while preserving the fine-grained semantics required for classification and description, making BFG suitable for privacy-friendly AIoT applications. This property concerns the processing pipeline and does not constitute a cryptographic privacy guarantee. The contributions of this paper are as follows:
blocks.zh:
我们提出BFG。
在Bitstream Fine-Grained Generator(BFG)中,Bitstream语义编码器(BSeE)从字节序列中取出紧凑的局部和全局语义,而其Fine-Grained语义生成器(FSeG)将这些语义与语言符号相配合,以产生详细的描述. 这种设计支持统一比特流框架内的分类和描述.
BFG也为AIoT提供了方便隐私的处理路径. 如图一所示,智能相机和边缘节点可能捕捉到RGB重建后直接可见于下游组件的面相,身份和私人环境[14]. BFG对被编码的字节进行语义推论,没有在其推论管内明确实现RGB图像. 因此可以减少像素-域外观曝光,同时保留分类和描述所需的精细纹理语义,使BFG适合隐私友好的AIoT应用. 这一财产涉及加工管道,不构成加密隐私保障。 本文件的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We construct the Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D). It augments the Stanford Dogs dataset with image-level natural language descriptions and adds bitstream corruption annotations to both Stanford Dogs and Flickr30k. This dataset transforms traditional image understanding tasks into a corrupted-bitstream vision-language benchmark, enabling systematic evaluation of fine-grained classification, description quality, and robustness under bitstream corruption. • We propose BFG with two coordinated modules for IBFU. BSeE extracts compact semantic representations directly from image byte sequences without pixel reconstruction, enabling bitstream-native fine-grained understanding. FSeG further combines local byte evidence with global context to generate fine-grained descriptions autoregressively. These modules allow BFG to jointly perform fine-grained classification and description on the same bitstream representation. • Experimental results show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained classification and caption, while pixel-domain models suffer significant performance decrease caused by bitstream corruption. This study provides a privacy-friendly paradigm for fine-grained understanding by reducing pixel-domain visual exposure.

blocks.en: II Related work
blocks.zh: 二. 有关工作

blocks.en: II-A Fine-grained Classification
blocks.zh: II-A 精细分类

blocks.en: In fine-grained classification, the core difficulty lies in small inter-class differences and large intra-class variations. This requires strong local detail perception. Early research focused on part detection and local alignment, explicitly or implicitly extracting key regions of the target to capture subtle differences [ 15 ] . With the development of deep learning, weakly supervised and self-supervised methods have been widely adopted. Weakly supervised methods learn discriminative local regions using only image-level labels. Self-supervised methods such as SimCLR and MAE learn robust representations via pretext tasks, improving performance in complex scenarios [ 16 ] . In recent years, with the development of vision-language pretraining, fine-grained research has gradually shifted toward higher-level semantic understanding and cross-modal fusion.
blocks.zh: 在精细分类中,核心难度在于阶级间差异小和阶级内差异大. 这需要强烈的当地细节感知. 早期的研究侧重于局部探测和地方对接,明确或含蓄地取出目标的关键区域来捕捉微妙的差异[15]. 随着深入学习的发展,薄弱的监管和自我监督的方法被广泛采用. 监督不力的方法只使用图像级别的标签来学习具有歧视性的局部地区。 SimCLR和MAE等自我监督的方法通过借口任务学习了强力的表述,提高了复杂情景中的性能[16]. 近年来,随着视觉语言预训的发展,精细的研究逐渐转向更高级的语义理解和跨模式聚变.

blocks.en: Models such as CLIP achieve strong cross-modal representation ability through image-text contrastive learning [ 17 ] . Generative models such as BLIP unify visual understanding and natural language generation [ 18 ] . Meanwhile, parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as prompt learning and LoRA enable large models to adapt efficiently to fine-grained tasks [ 19 ] . Recently, foundation models have attracted increasing attention. They are large-scale pre-trained general-purpose models that can adapt to various downstream tasks through fine-tuning or architectural adaptation [ 20 ] . They have shown strong generality and effectiveness in fields such as natural language processing, computer vision, and remote sensing [ 21 ] . However, existing foundation models are mainly built on pixel or text modalities. Few works explore models operating directly on byte-level bitstreams. In particular, there is no foundation model that supports unified byte-sequence input while jointly handling classification and description tasks under a privacy-preserving design.
blocks.zh: CLIP等模式通过图像-文本对比性学习实现强大的跨模式表现能力[17]. BLIP等基因模型统一了视觉理解和自然语言生成[18]. 同时,快速学习和LORA等参数高效的微调方法使大型模型能够高效地适应精细重心任务[19]. 最近,基金会模式引起了越来越多的关注。 它们是大型的预训通用模型,可以通过微调或建筑改造来适应下游的各种任务[20]. 它们在自然语言处理、计算机视觉和遥感等领域表现出了强烈的普遍性和有效性[21]。 然而,现有的基础模型主要是以像素或文字模式来构建的. 很少有作品探索直接在字节级比特流上运行的模型. 特别是,没有一个基础模型支持统一的字节序列输入,同时在隐私保护设计下共同处理分类和描述任务.

blocks.en: II-B Bitstream Understanding
blocks.zh: II-B 比特流理解

blocks.en: In the area of bitstream understanding, traditional visual understanding methods usually take fully decoded images as input. This leads to high computational overhead and storage requirements and makes the methods vulnerable to distortions. To reduce decoding dependency, researchers have turned to compressed-domain visual understanding. These methods directly model intermediate information generated during compression, such as DCT coefficients, quantization parameters, and JPEG block structures, to construct visual representations. This approach reduces computational complexity while preserving essential semantic information. It has been applied to tasks such as action recognition and video analysis [ 22 ] . Building on this, researchers have further explored end-to-end modeling directly on raw bitstreams. Wu et al. [ 11 ] proposed bGPT, which represents multimodal data uniformly as byte sequences, demonstrating the feasibility of byte-level unified representation. Horton et al. [ 10 ] proposed ByteFormer, which takes binary byte streams directly as input and bypasses the traditional decoding pipeline through byte embedding. To address the computational overhead caused by long byte sequences, Pagnoni et al. [ 23 ] adopted a hierarchical chunking strategy to reduce complexity. Kallini et al. [ 24 ] reduced sequence length by dynamically merging similar tokens. These methods reduce reliance on full decoding and show strong unified representation capability and computational efficiency. However, most of them assume a complete and stable bitstream. When the bitstream is corrupted or structurally abnormal, the feature representations become sensitive to noise, leading to performance degradation. Improving robustness under corrupted bitstream conditions remains an open problem.
blocks.zh: 在比特流理解领域,传统的视觉理解方法通常将完全解码的图像作为输入. 这导致高计算间接费用和存储要求,使方法容易被扭曲。 为了减少解码依赖性,研究人员转向了压缩-域视觉理解. 这些方法直接模拟了压缩过程中产生的中间信息,如DCT系数,量化参数,和JPEG块结构,以构建视觉表达. 这种方法在保存基本语义信息的同时降低了计算的复杂性. 它被应用于诸如行动识别和视频分析等任务 [22]. 在此基础上,研究人员进一步探索了直接在生取比特流上进行端到端模型. 吴等. [11] 提议的bGPT,它作为字节序列统一代表多式数据,显示了字节级统一代表的可行性. 霍顿等. [10] 提出了"ByteFormer",它直接将二进制字节流作为输入,并绕过传统的解码管通过字节嵌入. 为了解决由长字节序列引起的计算间接费用,Pagnoni等人, [23] 采取了分级划分战略以减少复杂性。 卡利尼等编. [24]通过动态地将相类似符合并来缩短序列长度. 这些方法减少了对完全解码的依赖,显示出强大的统一代表能力和计算效率. 然而,它们大多假设一个完整而稳定的比特流. 当位流被腐蚀或结构异常时,特征表现会变得对噪声敏感,导致性能退化. 在腐败的位流条件下提高稳健性仍然是一个公开的问题。

blocks.en: II-C Privacy Preservation in AIoT Systems
blocks.zh: II-C AIOT系统中的隐私保护

blocks.en: Privacy has become a central concern in AIoT systems, where smart cameras and edge sensors routinely capture images containing faces, identities, and other sensitive information. The heterogeneity of these devices and their frequent communication create a broad attack surface, making unauthorized access and data leakage persistent risks [ 14 ] . Various protective mechanisms have therefore been proposed. Authentication protocols and encryption techniques help secure data during transmission, while edge computing reduces the amount of sensitive information sent to the cloud by processing data locally [ 25 ] . In smart-home environments, multi-layer security frameworks that combine device-level identity verification, link encryption, and edge-side anomaly detection have also been explored [ 26 ] . These measures improve the protection of data in transit and storage, but they do not fully address the exposure that may occur when visual data is analyzed.
blocks.zh: 隐私已成为AIoT系统的核心关注,智能相机和边缘传感器经常捕捉包含面相,身份等敏感信息的图像. 这些装置的异质性及其频繁的通信造成了广泛的攻击地表,使未经授权的取用和数据泄露持续存在风险[14]. 因此,提出了各种保护机制。 认证协议和加密技术有助于传输过程中的数据安全,而边缘计算则通过本地处理数据来减少发送到云中的敏感信息的数量 [25]. 在智能家庭环境中,还探索了结合设备级身份验证,链接加密,边缘侧异常探测的多层安全框架 [26]. 这些措施改进了对过境和储存中的数据的保护,但并没有完全解决分析可视数据时可能出现的暴露问题。

blocks.en: In conventional vision pipelines, compressed images must be decoded into pixels before semantic analysis can be performed. This reconstruction creates a human-perceptible scene in system memory and makes visual details such as faces, home interiors, and personal belongings available to downstream processing components [ 27 ] . Data-minimization principles, including those emphasized by regulations such as the GDPR, therefore motivate approaches that limit unnecessary pixel-level exposure. Anonymization and obfuscation can hide sensitive regions, but may also remove fine-grained visual cues required for accurate recognition. Encryption protects data during storage and transmission, yet the image must generally be decrypted before pixel-based inference. Similarly, edge computing reduces transmission risks but still performs inference on decoded pixels at the local device [ 28 ] . These limitations have motivated research into compressed-domain and byte-level visual processing, which seeks to perform semantic analysis without explicitly reconstructing the full image. Such approaches are consistent with data-minimization and edge-processing principles, while their use for joint fine-grained classification and detailed description remains relatively underexplored.
blocks.zh: 在常规视觉管道中,压缩图像必须解码为像素后才能进行语义分析. 这种重建在系统记忆中创造了一个人能感知的场景,并使得面相,家用内饰等视觉细节,以及下游加工组件的个人物品[27]. 因此,数据最小化原则,包括GDPR等法规所强调原则,促使人们采取限制不必要的像素水平接触的方法。 匿名和模糊可以隐藏敏感区域,但也可能去除准确识别所需的精细的视觉提示. 加密保护了存储和传输期间的数据,然而图像一般必须在以像素为基础的推断之前被解密. 同样地,边缘计算降低了传输风险,但仍对本地设备的解码像素进行推论[28]. 这些限制推动了对压缩域和字节级视觉处理的研究,这种处理试图进行语义分析而没有明确重建完整的图像. 这种方法符合数据最小化和边缘处理原则,而将其用于联合精细分类和详细描述则相对未得到充分探讨。

blocks.en: III-A Problem Definition
blocks.zh: 三-A 问题定义

blocks.en: III-B BFG Architecture
blocks.zh: BFG 建筑结构

blocks.en: Fig. 2 shows the complete forward process of BFG. Given an image file, BFG reads the file as an ordered byte sequence instead of decoding it into RGB pixels. The byte sequence first passes through BSeE to produce a sequence of 192-dimensional bitstream features. The bitstream–language projector then converts these features into 512-dimensional features compatible with the language decoder. Finally, FSeG takes the projected bitstream features and the previously generated words as its two inputs and predicts the description one token at a time. The generated description covers the breed, appearance, pose, background, and atmosphere of the image.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了BFG的完整前进过程. 鉴于一个图像文件,BFG将文件读取为命令字节序列,而不是将其解码为RGB像素. 字节序列首先通过BSeE来产生192维比特流特征的序列. 比特流-语言投影器随后将这些特性转换为与语言解码器相兼容的512维特性. 最后,FSeG将预测的比特流特征和之前生成的单词作为其两个输入,并且一次一个地预测描述. 所生成的描述涵盖了图像的品种,外观,姿势,背景和氛围.

blocks.en: III-B 1 Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE)
blocks.zh: III-B 1 位流语义编码器(BSeE)

blocks.en: The input to BSeE is a JPEG bitstream B = ( b 1 , b 2 , … , b L ) B=(b_{1},b_{2},\ldots,b_{L}) , in which each b i b_{i} is an integer byte value between 0 and 255. Because different JPEG files contain different numbers of bytes, the sequences in a batch are padded to a common length, and a binary mask marks the valid positions. The byte-embedding layer first looks up a learnable vector for every byte value, converting the discrete sequence into a continuous feature sequence. The token-reduction layer then applies one-dimensional convolution along the sequence. Each convolutional output summarizes a group of neighboring byte embeddings, so the number of tokens is reduced before the more expensive attention calculation. Positional encoding is added after token reduction to retain the order of the compressed data. This first stage is written as H ( 0 ) = ℛ conv ​ ( ℰ b ​ ( B ) ) + P , H^{(0)}=\mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{conv}}\!\left(\mathcal{E}_{b}(B)\right)+P, (2) where ℰ b \mathcal{E}_{b} denotes byte embedding, ℛ conv \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{conv}} denotes Conv1D token reduction, and P P denotes positional encoding. The validity mask is reduced by the same stride, ensuring that padded positions are excluded from subsequent attention and pooling.
blocks.zh: 对 BSeE 的输入是一个 JPEG 比特流 B = (b 1, b 2,., b L ) B = (b_{ 1}, b_{ 2},\ ldots, b_{L }),其中每个 b i b_{i} 是一个整数字节值在 0到 255 之间. 由于不同的JPEG文件包含不同的字节数,一个批次中的序列被加成一个同长,而一个二进制口罩标记了有效的位置. 字节嵌入层首先查找每个字节值的可学习向量,将离散序列转换为连续特征序列. 符号还原层然后沿序列应用一维分解. 每一次演化输出都会总结出一组相邻的字节嵌入,因此在更昂贵的注意力计算之前会减少符数. 位置编码在符号还原后被添加来保留被压缩数据的顺序. 此第一阶段为 H (0) = R conv (E b (B)) + P; H (0) = mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{ conv}}\!\左 (\mathcal{E}_{b} (B)\right)+P; (2) 其中 E b = mathcal{ E}_{b} 表示字节嵌入; R conv{R}_{\mathrm{conv} 表示 Conv1D 符号减少; P 表示位置编码. 有效性口罩被同一种步调所减小,确保了被后期关注和集合的加分位置被排除在外.

blocks.en: The position-aware sequence H ( 0 ) H^{(0)} next enters 12 encoder blocks. In each block, windowed self-attention divides the long sequence into local windows and computes the relationships among tokens within each window. The resulting features pass through a feed-forward network, with residual connections and normalization applied around the attention and feed-forward operations. Successive blocks use shifted windows so that tokens located in neighboring windows can exchange information. At selected blocks, a token-merging operation combines adjacent tokens and shortens the sequence again. Consequently, the early blocks model short byte patterns, whereas the later blocks receive progressively larger bitstream contexts.
blocks.zh: 位置感知序列 H (0) H (0)} 接下来进入 12 个编码器块 。 在每个块中,窗口自意将长序分入本地窗口并计算出每个窗口内符号之间的关系. 由此产生的特点通过一个向导网络,在注意力和向导业务方面有剩余的连接和正常化。 相继的块会使用被转动的窗口来使位于相邻窗口中的符号可以交换信息. 在所选择的块上,一个符号-并列操作结合相邻的符号,并再次缩短序列. 因此,早期的区块模型短字节模式,而后期的区块得到的比特流环境则逐渐扩大.

These features still belong to the bitstream representation space. blocks.en: On the text branch, each previous token is mapped to a 512-dimensional word embedding, and positional encoding is added to indicate its position in the sentence. Causal self-attention then processes this text sequence. Its causal mask allows the representation at position t t to attend only to tokens at positions up to t t , preventing access to future words. The resulting language feature is combined with the global bitstream feature g B g_{B} by global-context fusion. Specifically, g B g_{B} is broadcast to all text positions, concatenated with each language feature, and mapped back to the decoder dimension through a fusion layer with a residual connection and normalization.

The cross-attended representation then passes through a feed-forward network, residual connection, and normalization to produce the updated language feature. This decoder process is repeated for three stacked layers.

blocks.en: After the third layer, a vocabulary projection and softmax convert the language feature at the last position into probabilities for the next token. The selected token is appended to the existing text sequence and fed back into FSeG for the next decoding step. This autoregressive loop continues until ⟨ E ​ O ​ S ⟩ \langle EOS\rangle is generated or the maximum length is reached. The final output is a natural-language description rather than five independent classification scores; its sentences describe the breed, appearance, pose, background, and atmosphere.
blocks.zh: 第三层后,一个词汇投影和软max将上个位置的语言特征转换为下个符号的概率. 所选的令牌被附加在现有文本序列上并反馈回FSeG,用于下一个解码步骤. 此自旋回路一直持续到 QQ E O S \ langle EOS\rangle 生成或达到最大长度. 最终输出是自然语言描述,而不是五个独立的分类分数;其句子描述品种,外观,姿势,背景,和大气.

blocks.en: III-C Construction of CFU-D
blocks.zh: 三-C 建设CFU-D

blocks.en: We construct the Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D) to support both outputs of IBFU under intact and corrupted conditions. The construction pipeline contains three stages, Dataset Composition and Description Generation, bitstream serialization, and corruption generation. Each derived sample remains linked to its source identifier and original data split so that different bitstream versions of the same image cannot cross the training and test partitions.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了被腐蚀-bitstream Fine-Grained Conservation数据集(CFU-D),以支持IBFU在完整和被腐蚀的条件下的输出. 建造管道包括三个阶段:数据集构成和描述生成、位流序列化和腐败生成。 每个衍生样本仍然与其源标识符相接,原始数据被分解,这样同一图像的不同比特流版本无法跨越训练并测试分区.

blocks.en: The source layer combines two complementary forms of supervision. Stanford Dogs provides fine-grained breed labels and is used to build the dog image classification and description subset. Its semantic target is organized as a structured natural-language description covering the breed, visual appearance, pose or activity, scene background, and overall atmosphere. To generate this target, we query the Qwen-VL-Max API with each source image and include the ground-truth breed name in the prompt. The API returns five to six sentences that begin with “The dog is a [breed].”, where the breed name is inserted from the ground-truth folder label. We then check the returned text for the required descriptive fields, including appearance, pose or activity, scene background, and overall atmosphere, and retain the generated description as the semantic target. We manually inspected a random subset of the generated descriptions and found them to be reasonable and consistent with the source images. Breed mentions are thus anchored to the ground-truth category, while the remaining visual content is generated from the source image and verified against the required fields. Flickr30k contributes diverse scenes and human-written references, providing description supervision beyond dog images without additional API generation. Together, these sources allow CFU-D to evaluate both category-sensitive descriptions and more general semantic generation.
blocks.zh: 源层结合了两种互补形式的监督. Stanford Dogs提供细纹的品种标签并用于构建狗的图像分类和描述子集. 它的语义目标被组织成结构化的自然语言描述,涵盖品种,视觉外观,姿势或活性,场景背景,以及整体大气. 为了生成这个目标,我们用每个源图像查询Quen-VL-Max API,并在即时输入地真种名. API返回了从“狗是[生].”开始的五到六句,从地-真文件夹标签上插入了品种名。 然后检查返回的文字,以了解所需的描述字段,包括外观、姿势或活性、场景背景和整体气氛,并保留生成的描述作为语义目标。 我们手动检查了所生成的描述的一个随机子集,发现其合理并符合源图像. 因此,Breed提到的内容被固定在地面真实类别中,而其余的可视内容则由源图像产生,并对照所需的字段加以核实。 Flickr30k提供多种场景和人文参考,提供描述监督,超越狗影像而不增加API生成. 这些来源加在一起,使得CFU-D既可以评价对类别敏感的描述,也可以评价更普遍的语义生成.

blocks.en: Bitstream serialization encodes every source image into a byte sequence and pairs it with its semantic targets. The dataset retains the intact stream as the reference input and records the valid sequence length, category label when available, textual references, source split, and encoding information. This organization separates the visual carrier (the byte sequence) from the task supervision (the class and text), enabling the same bitstream representation to support classification and generation.
blocks.zh: 比特流序列化将每个源图像编码成字节序列并与其语义目标相配. 数据集保留了完整流为参考输入并记录了有效的序列长度,可用时的分类标签,文本引用,源分解,和编码信息. 这个组织将视觉载体(字节序列)与任务监督(类和正文)分开,使得同样的位流代表支持分类和生成.

blocks.en: Corruption generation derives corrupted variants from each intact stream using replacement, deletion, and repetition. Replacement changes selected byte values while preserving stream length, modeling value errors. Deletion removes selected bytes and shifts the following sequence, modeling information loss or incomplete transfer. Repetition duplicates selected bytes or short spans, modeling redundant insertion, retransmission, or stream-reassembly faults. Each operator is applied independently at multiple severity levels. Fig. 3 illustrates these corruption patterns on the bitstream.
blocks.zh: 腐败的产生通过替换、删除和重复从每条完整流中产生腐败变体。 替换修改选中的字节值同时保留流长,建模值错误. 删除删除所选择的字节并改变以下序列,建模信息丢失或不完全传输. 重复重复所选择的字节或短跨,模拟冗余插入,再传输,或流重组断层. 每个操作员在多重严重性级别上独立应用. 图3说明了这些腐败模式在位流。

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Datasets
blocks.zh: IV-A 1 数据集

blocks.en: We construct CFU-D as the evaluation resource for IBFU. CFU-D organizes intact image bitstreams and controlled corrupted variants across replacement, deletion, and repetition faults at multiple severity levels. It contains two complementary settings. Stanford Dogs supports fine-grained recognition and description, while Flickr30k evaluates general semantic description with human-written references. We use the official Stanford Dogs split with 12,000 training images and 8,580 test images while Flickr30k evaluates general semantic description and contains 31,783 images, each with five human-written captions.Together, these two settings support a comprehensive evaluation of IBFU under both intact and corrupted bitstreams.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了CFU-D作为IBFU的评价资源. CPU-D组织完好无损的图像比特流并控制被腐蚀的变体,跨越多重度级的替换,删除和重复断层. 它包含两个互补的设置. Stanford Dogs支持精细的识别和描述,而Flickr30k则用人文参考评价一般语义描述. Flickr30k评价一般语义描述, 包含31,783个图像, 各有5个人写字幕。 这两个设置一起支持在完整和被腐蚀的位流下对IBFU进行综合评价.

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 执行细节

blocks.en: All experiments are implemented in PyTorch with CUDA on a single NVIDIA GPU. Images are resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , center-cropped to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , and encoded as JPEG with quality 90. Byte sequences are truncated or padded to 16,384 positions. The captioning model contains 35.257M parameters, including a frozen 15.580M-parameter ImageNet-pretrained ByteFormer and 19.677M trainable parameters; the stored weights require approximately 141 MB.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都是在PyTorch与CUDA在单NVIDIA GPU上进行的. 图像被调整为:256×256 256\times 256,中-克被调整为:224×224\times 224,并被编码为质量90的JPEG. 字节序列被截断或加成16,384个位置. 标题模型包含35.257M参数,包括被冻结的15.580M参数ImageNet预装字节Former和19.677 M可训练参数;所储存的重量需要约141 MB.

blocks.en: We use ByteFormer-Tiny with a 192-dimensional embedding, 12 Transformer layers, and three attention heads. The caption decoder contains three Transformer layers with a hidden dimension of 512, eight attention heads, a 2,048-dimensional feed-forward network, and dropout of 0.1. The maximum output length is 150 tokens. The model is trained for 20 epochs using Adam with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch size 16, label smoothing of 0.1, gradient clipping at 1.0, 10% linear warm-up, and cosine decay. Caption generation uses greedy autoregressive decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们使用 ByteFormer-Tiny 并有一个192维的嵌入, 12个变形器层, 和三个注意头。 字幕解码器包含3个变形器层,隐藏维度为512个,8个注意头,2,048维的向导网络,退出0.1. 最大输出长度为150个令牌. 该模型为20个时代所训练,使用Adam的学习率为5×10−4 5\times 10×4}体重衰变为10−4 10×4}分批尺寸为16,标签平滑为0.1,梯度剪接为1.0,线性暖和为10%,并有余弦衰变. 标题生成使用贪婪自递解码.

blocks.en: With batch size 1 and 16,384-byte inputs on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, the complete caption-generation pipeline requires 236.6 ms per sample on average, achieves 4.2 samples/s, and uses 223.1 MiB of peak CUDA memory. ByteFormer uses local-window attention and hierarchical sequence reduction, while decoder cost grows with the generated length.
blocks.zh: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090上的批量尺寸1和16,384字节输入,完整的标题生成管道平均需要每个样本236.6毫秒,实现4.2个样本/秒,并使用峰值CUDA内存的223.1米B. ByteFormer使用本地窗口的注意力和分级顺序还原,而解码器的成本随着生成的长度而增长.

blocks.en: IV-A 3 Comparison Methods and Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 比较方法和评价计量

blocks.en: For fine-grained classification, we compare BFG-Direct with DCT-CNN, BLOCK-CNN [29], bGPT, MBLM, MegaByte, and MambaByte. BFG-Direct uses the ByteFormer encoder with a 120-class linear head and is trained only with JPEG bytes and breed labels. All methods use the official Stanford Dogs split. We report accuracy, macro precision, macro recall, macro F1-score, and balanced accuracy. We initialize BFG-Direct with ImageNet-pretrained weights, as detailed in the experimental setup.
blocks.zh: 对于精细分级分类,我们比较BFG-Direct与DCT-CNN,BLOCK-CNN [29],bGPT,MBLM,MegaByte,和曼巴Byte. BFG-Direct使用有120级线性头的ByteFormer编码器,并且只经过了JPEG字节和品种标签的训练. 所有方法都使用官方的"斯坦福狗"分出. 我们报告准确性,宏观精确性,宏观召回性,宏观F1分分数,均衡准确性. 如实验设置所详述的,我们以ImageNet预受重量初始化了BFG-Direct.

blocks.en: For caption generation, BFG is compared with Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM-4.6V-Flash, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and GPT-5.1. BFG processes JPEG bytes directly, whereas the pixel-domain models require JPEG decoding before inference. Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, and GLM are evaluated locally and contain 7B, 3.8B, and 9B parameters, respectively. Gemini-2.5-Flash and GPT-5.1 are proprietary API-based models with undisclosed parameter counts. Due to API cost, Gemini and GPT are evaluated on fixed subsets rather than the full test sets. We evaluate caption quality and decoding availability under the same corrupted-file conditions.
blocks.zh: 对于字幕生成,BFG与Quen-VL-Chat,BLIP-2,GLM-4.6V-Flash,双子座-2.5-Flash,和GPT-5.1作比较. BFG直接处理JPEG字节,而像素域模型则在推论前需要JPEG解码. Quen-VL-Chat,BLIP-2和GLM分别在当地评价并包含7B,3.8B和9B参数. 双子座-2.5-Flash和GPT-5.1是专有的API型模型,有未披露参数计数. 由于API成本,双子座和GPT在固定子集上而不是全部测试集上进行评估. 我们评价标题质量,并在同样腐败的文件条件下解码可用性。

blocks.en: Robustness is evaluated with three reproducible byte-level fault models. Replace substitutes 2%, 5%, or 10% of eligible byte values with randomly sampled values. Drop removes the same proportions of byte positions. Repeat selects 10% or 20% of positions and repeats each selected byte two to four times. These operations represent value corruption, information loss, and redundant insertion that may arise from transmission errors, packet loss, incomplete transfer, interrupted writes, storage damage, retransmission, or stream-reassembly faults.
blocks.zh: 稳健性通过三种可复制的字节级断层模型进行评估. 用随机抽取的值来替换2%,5%,或合格字节值的10%. 丢弃去相同比例的字节位置。 重复选择10%或20%的职位,并重复每个被选择的字节2到4次. 这些操作代表着由于传输错误、数据包丢失、传输不完整、写作中断、存储损坏、再传输或流组装故障而可能产生的价值腐败、信息丢失和冗余插入。

blocks.en: Fault positions are sampled without replacement using random seed 42, while the first four JPEG signature bytes are preserved. The reported percentages indicate controlled application-level corruption severity rather than physical-layer bit-error rates. For pixel-domain models, undecodable files receive zero semantic scores, and decoding rate is reported separately. Caption quality is measured using BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, METEOR, CIDEr, and BERTScore-F1.
blocks.zh: 断层位置不使用随机种子42进行取样而进行替换,而前四个JPEG签名字节保存. 报告的百分比表明控制在应用层面的腐败严重性,而不是物理层比特率。 对于像素域模型,不可解码文件获得零语义分数,解码率另行报告. 说明质量用BLEU-4、ROUGE-L、METEOR、CIDER和BERTScore-F1测量。

blocks.en: IV-B Evaluations on Bitstream-Domain Fine-Grained Classification Task
blocks.zh: 关于Bitstream-Domain精细分类任务的评价

blocks.en: Table I reports a controlled direct-classification comparison. BFG-Direct achieves 58.51% breed accuracy on the official test split of 8,580 images. It uses a standard 120-way classification head. Compared with the other bitstream-domain models, BFG-Direct demonstrates markedly stronger fine-grained category recognition under the same evaluation setting.
blocks.zh: 表一报告有控制的直接分类比较。 BFG-Direct在8,580个图像的官方测试分取上实现了58.51%的品种精度. 它使用标准的120道分类头. 与其他比特流域模型相比,BFG-Direct显示在同一个评价环境下明显更强的细纹类识别.

blocks.en: To more intuitively illustrate the differences in fine-grained classification performance across models, we select the 10 most frequently predicted breeds and present the confusion matrices of all models in Fig. 4 . BFG’s confusion matrix exhibits a strong diagonal structure, with the vast majority of samples correctly classified into their corresponding breeds and only minor inter-breed confusion. The confusion matrices of BLOCK-CNN and DCT-CNN show that a large proportion of predictions fall outside the 10 target classes, with diagonal values of only 12-25%, indicating that compression-domain methods have limited capability in fine-grained breed discrimination. bGPT’s confusion matrix reveals mode collapse, with all samples predicted as afghan hound. The confusion matrices of MBLM, MegaByte, and MambaByte are extremely sparse, with nearly all predictions falling outside the 10 target breeds. These results further confirm that these models exhibit near-random discriminative ability on the 120-class fine-grained task.
blocks.zh: 为了更直观地说明各模型之间精细分级性能的差异,我们选择了十种最常被预测的品种,并呈现出Fig中所有模型的混淆矩阵. 4. BFG的混淆矩阵显示出强烈的对角结构,绝大多数样本被正确分类为相应的品种,只有细小的间生混淆. BLOCK-CNN和DCT-CNN的混淆矩阵显示,很大一部分预测值都低于10个目标类别,对角值仅为12-25%,这表明压缩-域法在细纹品种歧视方面能力有限. BGPT 的混淆矩阵显示模式崩溃, 所有样本都预言是afghan猎犬。 MBLM,MegaByte,和MambaByte的混淆矩阵极为稀少,几乎所有的预测都落在了10个目标品种之外. 这些结果进一步证实,这些模型在120级精细任务上表现出了近乎随机的区别能力.

blocks.en: IV-C Evaluations on Robustness of Bitstream-Domain Caption Task
blocks.zh: IV-C 关于Bitstream-Domain 标题任务的强性评价

blocks.en: TABLE III : Performance comparison on Flickr30k under different corruption strategies.
blocks.zh: 表三: 国家 Flickr30k在不同的腐败策略下的表现比较.

blocks.en: We evaluate description robustness on Stanford Dogs Caption and Flickr30k in Tables II and III , respectively. Stanford Dogs Caption tests label-informed fine-grained descriptions, whereas Flickr30k tests general descriptions written by humans. On clean inputs, BLIP-2 obtains the highest Stanford Dogs CIDEr and BERTScore-F1 among the locally evaluated models, while GLM obtains the highest breed accuracy and METEOR. On Flickr30k, BFG obtains BLEU-4 of 0.1063 and ROUGE-L of 0.3005. These results show that the compact BFG model retains competitive semantic-generation capability on intact inputs.
blocks.zh: 我们分别评价表二和表三中Stanford Dogs Caption和Flickr30k的描述。 Stanford Dogs Caption测试标签信息精细描述,而Flickr30k测试一般描述由人类编写. 在清洁输入方面,BLIP-2在当地评价的模型中获得了最高的斯坦福犬类CIDER和BERTScore-F1,而GLM则获得了最高的品种精度和METEOR. 在Flickr30k上,BFG获得0.1063的BLEU-4和0.3005的ROUGE-L. 这些结果表明,紧凑的BFG模型保留了对完整投入的竞争性语义生成能力.

blocks.zh: 图7:Flickr30k上的BFG和视觉语言模型的强健对比. 每个轴线代表一个腐败条件。 上行为BERTScore-F1,下行为METEOR. BFG覆盖了所有条件中最大的区域.

blocks.zh: 图8:2%字节替换下模型生成描述的可视比较.

blocks.en: However, once bitstream corruption is introduced, a clear performance gap emerges between the two groups of models. This is illustrated in Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 through CIDEr comparisons and retention rate heatmaps on the two datasets. On both datasets, under replacement and dropping strategies, BFG’s CIDEr decreases by only approximately 1% to 2%, and the retention rates of most metrics remain above 90%, indicating strong robustness. In contrast, vision-language models suffer severe degradation two aspects. First, corrupted bitstreams may fail to be decoded by standard decoders, leaving pixel-domain models without valid inputs. On both datasets, the decoding rates of locally deployed models (Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM) decrease to approximately 60% under 2% byte replacement, around 10% under 5% byte dropping, and approach 0% under 10% byte dropping. API-based models (Gemini-2.5-Flash, GPT-5.1) fail entirely under any corruption. In contrast, BFG operates directly in the bitstream domain, thereby avoiding the decoding stage and maintaining complete inputs under all conditions. Second, even when decoding succeeds, the description quality of vision-language models degrades drastically. On Stanford Dogs Caption, under 5% byte replacement, BLIP-2’s CIDEr drops from 1.5478 to 0.3666 (76.3% decrease) and breed accuracy drops from 42.61% to 1.72%; GLM’s CIDEr drops from 0.2785 to 0.0207 (92.6% decrease). On Flickr30k, under 5% byte dropping, BLIP-2’s CIDEr drops to 0.0055 (90% decrease), GLM’s to 0.0022 (92% decrease), and Qwen-VL-Chat’s CIDEr is near zero. Decoding distortion causes models to generate descriptions unrelated to the actual content, resulting in severe hallucinations.
blocks.zh: 然而,一旦引入了比特流腐败,这两类模式之间就出现了明显的绩效差距. 图5和图6通过两个数据集的CIDER比较和保留率热图说明了这一点。 在两个数据集中,在替换和下降策略下,BFG的CIDEr只减少了大约1%到2%,大多数度量衡的留存率仍然超过90%,这表明强势。 与此相反,视觉语言模型受到严重的退化。 首先被腐蚀的比特流可能无法被标准解码器解码,使得像素域模型没有有效的输入. 在两个数据集中,当地部署的模型(Quen-VL-Chat、BLIP-2、GLM)的解码率下降到2%字节替换后约60%,5%字节下降后约10%,10%字节下降后接近0%。 基于API的模型(Gemini-2.5-Flash,GPT-5.1)在任何腐败下完全失败. 相形之下,BFG直接在比特流域内运行,从而避免了解码阶段,并在所有条件下保持完整的输入. 第二,即使解码成功,视觉语言模型的描述质量也急剧下降. 在"斯坦福狗"(Stanford Dogs Caption)上,低于5%的字节替换,BLIP-2的CIDER从1.5478降至0.3666(76.3%)并育种精度从42.61%降至1.72%;GLM的CIDER从0.2785降至0.0207(92.6%). 在Flickr30k上,不到5%的字节下降,BLIP-2的CIDER下降为0.0055(减少90%),GLM下降为0.0022(减少92%),而Qun-VL-Chat的CIDER接近于零. 解码扭曲导致模型生成与实际内容无关的描述,导致严重的幻觉.

blocks.en: Fig. 7 compares the robustness of BFG and vision-language models under different corruption conditions using BERTScore-F1 and METEOR. Each radar chart has five axes corresponding to the intact bitstream condition, 2% byte replacement, 5% byte replacement, 2% byte dropping, and 5% byte dropping. On BERTScore-F1, BFG remains stable across all corruption levels. The radar area is almost unchanged. In contrast, vision-language models shrink sharply from the intact bitstream condition. METEOR shows a similar trend. These radar plots clearly reveal the performance gap between models. They also highlight the robustness advantage of bitstream-domain modeling under corruption.
blocks.zh: 图7利用BERTScore-F1和METEOR比较了不同腐败条件下BFG和视觉语言模型的稳健性. 每个雷达图有5个轴对应于完好无缺的比特流条件,2%字节替换,5%字节替换,2%字节下降,5%字节下降. 关于BERTScore-F1,BFG在所有腐败级别上保持稳定。 雷达区域几乎没有变化. 相形之下,视觉语言模型从完整的比特流条件急剧收缩. METEOR显示出类似的趋势. 这些雷达图清楚地揭示出模型之间的性能差距. 它们还突出了在腐败下进行比特流域建模的强大优势。

blocks.en: Fig. 9 : Visual comparison of model-generated descriptions on Flickr30k different bitstream corruption.
blocks.zh: 图9:Flickr30k不同比特流腐败模式生成描述的可视比较.

blocks.en: Fig. 8 shows a comparison of generated captions on the Stanford Dogs Caption dataset under intact and corrupted conditions with 2% byte replacement. Under intact conditions, all models correctly identify the breed and generate reasonable descriptions. Under corruption, the baseline vision-language models still produce outputs, but their descriptions become less accurate, often exhibiting breed misclassification and scene hallucination. In contrast, BFG remains robust and continues to produce correct breed-level descriptions with only minor attribute changes. Fig. 9 presents results on the Flickr30k dataset under intact, replacement, dropping, and repetition conditions. Baseline vision-language models show noticeable degradation even under mild corruption and produce severely erroneous outputs under stronger corruption conditions due to decoding errors. BFG avoids these decoding failures and continues to generate descriptions from the corrupted bitstreams. Under the severe 20% repetition condition, however, its output becomes less precise: the main subject remains recognizable, but the person-to-person interaction is described incorrectly. This example shows that BFG preserves input availability under severe corruption, while fine-grained semantic accuracy can still degrade when repetition disrupts the byte sequence. Overall, the results demonstrate that bitstream corruption causes both decoding failures and semantic distortion in vision-language models, whereas BFG avoids the decoding stage and remains functional under corruption.
blocks.zh: 图8显示在完好无损且腐烂的条件下,斯坦福狗笼盖数据集生成的字幕的对比值为2%字节替换. 在完好无损的条件下,所有模型都正确识别出品种并生成合理的描述. 在腐败下,基线视觉语言模型仍然产生出产出,但其描述的准确度更低,往往表现出品种分类错误和场景幻觉. 相形之下,BFG依然坚固,并继续产生正确的品种级描述,只有微小的属性变化. 图9列出了Flickr30k数据集在完整、更换、下降和重复条件下的结果。 基线视觉语言模型显示,即使在轻微腐败的情况下,也明显退化;由于解码错误,在更强烈的腐败条件下产生严重错误的产出。 BFG避免了这些解码失败,并继续从被腐蚀的位流产生描述. 然而,在严重的20%的重复条件下,其输出变得不太精确:主体仍然可以识别,但人与人之间的互动被错误地描述. 这个例子表明BFG在严重腐败下保留了输入的可用性,而细纹语义精度在重复扰乱字节序列时仍然可以被降解. 总体来看,结果显示,比特流腐败既会给视觉语言模型解码故障也会造成语义扭曲,而BFG则会避免解码阶段,在腐败下仍然能发挥作用.

blocks.en: It is worth noting that the byte repetition strategy has a larger impact on BFG compared to replacement and dropping strategies. Under repetition, BFG’s breed accuracy drops more noticeably than under the other two strategies. This is because byte repetition changes the overall length and structure of the bitstream, affecting ByteFormer’s sequence compression and windowed attention mechanisms. Nevertheless, BFG still maintains full input availability under all conditions, whereas the decoding rates of vision-language models under repetition do not exceed 21.7%, and their breed accuracy is virtually 0%.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,与替换和下降战略相比,字节重复战略对BFG的影响更大. 在重复的情况下,BFG的品种精度比其他两种策略更明显地下降. 这是因为字节重复会改变比特流的整体长度和结构,影响ByteFormer的序列压缩和窗口的注意机制. 尽管如此,BFG在所有条件下仍然保持完全的输入可用性,而重复的视觉语言模型的解码率不超过21.7%,其品种精度几乎为0%.

blocks.en: IV-D Ablation on byte-level corruption augmentation
blocks.zh: 四-D 字节级腐败的加重

blocks.en: We conduct an ablation on byte-level corruption augmentation using Stanford Dogs Caption and Flickr30k, training BFG with and without this augmentation while keeping the architecture, initialization, data split, optimizer, and checkpoint-selection rule fixed. Tables IV and V report the average results across corruption severities for each strategy, together with the overall average across corrupted inputs. Parenthesized values indicate relative changes from the corresponding clean-input score.
blocks.zh: 我们利用斯坦福狗帽和Flickr30k对字节级的腐败强化进行检讨, 表四和五报告每项战略在腐败断裂方面的平均结果,以及腐败投入方面的总体平均数。 括号大小的值表示从相应的干净输入分数的相对变化.

blocks.en: On Stanford Dogs Caption, byte masking reduces the average degradation for most metrics; for example, the overall BERTScore-F1 drop decreases from 9.10% to 5.47%. On Flickr30k, its clearest benefit appears in the average results under repetition. Overall, the ablation shows that byte masking improves caption stability under corrupted inputs.
blocks.zh: 在"斯坦福狗"(Stanford Dogs Caption)上,字节口罩降低了大多数公分量的平均降解率;例如,总体BERTScore-F1的下降率从9.10%下降到了5.47%. Flickr30k显示, 总的来看,删减表明字节掩码在被腐蚀的投入下改善了标题稳定性.

blocks.en: IV-E Zero-shot Generalization to Other Image Formats
blocks.zh: IV- E 零射入其他图像格式

blocks.en: We use the cross-format experiment in Table VI to assess whether BFG’s bitstream understanding extends beyond JPEG. The results show substantially lower caption scores on WebP and PNG, with breed accuracy of 0.44% on both formats. Thus, BFG’s current generalization is limited to JPEG bitstreams.
blocks.zh: 我们利用表六中的跨格式实验来评估BFG的位流理解是否超越了JPEG. 结果显示WebP和PNG的字幕分数低得多,两种格式的品种精度都为0.44%. 因此,BFG目前的通化仅限于JPEG比特流.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduces IBFU and presents BFG for fine-grained classification and semantic description directly from encoded image bitstreams. BSeE extracts compact semantic representations from JPEG bytes, while FSeG combines local evidence with global context to generate detailed descriptions. We also construct CFU-D, which contains intact bitstreams and corrupted variants across multiple corruption types and severity levels for evaluating fine-grained classification, description quality, and robustness. Experiments show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained caption generation under bitstream corruption, whereas pixel-domain vision-language models suffer severe performance degradation or decoding failure. In addition, BFG reduces pixel-domain visual exposure within the inference pipeline, offering a practical pathway for privacy-friendly fine-grained understanding in AIoT.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍IBFU,并直接从编码的图像比特流中为精细分级和语义描述提供BFG. BSeE从JPEG字节中取出紧凑的语义表述,而FSeG则将本地证据与全局背景相结合来生成详细的描述. 我们还构建了CFU-D,它包含完整的位流和腐败变体,涉及多种腐败类型和严重程度,用于评价精细分类、描述质量和稳健性。 实验显示,BFG在比特流腐败下保持了稳定的精细字幕生成,而像素-域视觉语言模型则会遭受严重的性能退化或解码故障. 此外,BFG在推论管内减少了像素-域外观曝光,为AIoT中方便隐私的精细分辨提供了实用途径.
